description: Full Grateful Dead live catalog on the CyberCat deck. Every available show — soundboards, audience tapes, matrices, remasters. Best waveform loads by default; Other Transfers opens alternates. Date + venue on the deck is enough to research any tape elsewhere.

manuals.title: CyberCat Curator Guide
manuals.description: How the deck is curated and maintained

provenance.origin: First non-root uXu archive room: a Grateful Dead live catalog deck. Performances come from the public taping tradition; streams are resolved via ReListen / Internet Archive catalog APIs. Deck UI and curation live in the uXu repo under archives/CyberCat-Sunflower.
authors: Victor Birkle III (curator, deck software, original docs)
Grateful Dead (performances — not owned by this archive)
Tapers and public transfer stewards (audio sources under their own terms)
provenance.custody: Archive room stewarded by Victor Birkle III / RASvibir in github.com/RASvibir/uXu (CyberCat_Sunflower.uXu.0001).
provenance.lineage: Registered as CyberCat_Sunflower.uXu.0001 under 0?0.uXu.0000. Evolved from a curated landmark-show deck toward a full-catalog browser with best-waveform default and Other Transfers for alternates. iNi opt-in attested 2026-08-12; paper trail article in RASvibir/iNi.
provenance.conditions: Deck code and original docs: MIT (uXu LICENSE). Audio streams: Internet Archive / ReListen and related public sources under their own terms and the Grateful Dead taping tradition — this archive does not own those recordings. iNi fields are self-attestation only, not a rights certificate.
